engine_correction_2026-08-24.defect: All strategy-layer runners passed ret = np.log(close).diff() to opt.run_ls / pp.run_s1, where it is consumed as arithmetic position PnL (w*r summed, then (1+net).cumprod()). A short position's daily PnL is -(simple return); crediting -log(1+x) injects +0.5*sigma^2/day. The champion family is long low-vol / short high-vol, so the spurious drift lands on the short leg. Kill-test (same engine/panels/config, expm1 conversion = identical NaN support): ovl SR +1.892 -> -0.371; short leg log +39.1 vs simple -10.2 bp/d, matching the 0.5*sigma^2 prediction leg-by-leg.
engine_correction_2026-08-24.fix: ret = close.pct_change(fill_method=None) in predlab_opt_o1.inputs, predlab_pp_dev.s1_inputs, predlab_pp_holdout.inputs, predlab_bybit_r1, predlab_xasset_r1.equity_inputs, predlab_futfx_r1.inputs; predlab_s1_paper realized_prev_return / realized_prev_mark_return switched to simple returns. Regression test added (short of a volatile synthetic path must book exactly -simple).
